# JustGloves

> > JustGloves is a UK supplier of disposable gloves, infection control products, first aid supplies, safety signage, and workplace safety equipment for healthcare, catering, and industrial sectors.

JustGloves specializes in compliance-focused protective equipment including Ansell and Bodyguards gloves, antimicrobial dispensers, HSE-compliant first aid kits, GDPR/ICO posters, and CPD-certified training courses. Products meet standards including EN388, BS8599-1, and EN ISO 7010 for workplace safety and infection control.

## Key Topics

- Disposable Gloves (Nitrile, Latex, Vinyl)
- Infection Control & Hygiene
- Ansell & Bodyguards Brands
- HSE Compliance
- GDPR & ICO Data Protection
- EN388 & AQL 1.5 Standards
- First Aid & BS8599-1
- CPD-Certified Training
- Antimicrobial Equipment
- Healthcare & Catering Supplies
- Safety Signage (EN ISO 7010)
- MRSA & Bacterial Protection
- Powder-Free Gloves
- Workplace Safety Equipment
